description: This line plot illustrates the average performance metrics—Precision, Recall, and F1-score—as a function of model size, with the x-axis labeled “Model Size (log scale)” ranging from 70m to 7.0B, and the y-axis labeled “Avg. Performance (%)” ranging from 0 to 80. The x-axis uses a logarithmic scale with tick labels at 70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B. The y-axis is linear, with tick marks at 0, 20, 40, 60, and 80. Three distinct lines represent the metrics: Precision is shown as a red line with triangle markers, starting at approximately 78% at 70m and decreasing slightly to around 75% at 7.0B; Recall is depicted as a blue line with triangle markers, beginning at approximately 8% at 70m and increasing to about 45% at 7.0B; and F1-score is represented by a purple line with triangle markers, starting at approximately 15% at 70m and rising to about 58% at 7.0B. All three lines show a general upward trend in performance as model size increases, with Precision remaining relatively high and stable, Recall increasing steadily, and F1-score showing the most significant growth.
